subject: economics
objective: What compound growth rate does this series imply?
instruction: The Eastmark industrial region: Real output was USD 2,350,000,000 at the start and USD 3,910,000,000 at the end of a span of 12 year(s), while the population went from 14,500 to 16,100. Use compound (geometric) annual rates: g = (end / start)^(1/periods) - 1, applied separately to output, to population and to output per person. Periods are years. Required: average annual growth rate, population growth rate, per capita start, per capita end, per capita annual growth rate.
